architecture.summary: Admin Quick start adds GET/HEAD quick-start in the existing web owner. The route requires the session-selected organization, matching current identity and organization, product access, exact Admin role, and a current nonblank organization name from the existing authorizeSelection read. App supplies the configured MCP URL through a new required HostedAccountRoutesOptions member. After successful new-organization activation and checked session selection, signup redirects to Quick start instead of the portal root; later sign-ins and normal workspace selection retain Connect. The page renders the complete setup guide and Markdown copy with trusted configured URLs and safe manual fallback. Current-Admin menus put Quick start first. Existing components, dependencies, providers, stores, and deployment remain unchanged. Registry prose records the guide, navigation, and creation landing; all 20 Mermaid views remain unchanged.
